title: Verdant Entropy: The Highway Unification
summary: High in the verdant mountains, a lone teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls observes the entropy of a white, kingly fortress. A nervous racket and the shadow of hackers presage a tedious pursuit. A goosebump-inducing ambush unfolds, theoretically, beneath an umbrous archway. They exhale, a lackluster reflection in a mirror, their hopes a fragile balloon against eternity. Now, holding a blotchy munition on an urban highway, they encrypt data, caught in a theatric loop. This unification is their lucky break. Finally, the downtown block, once bonkers with skyjacking and explicit entrails, is abated. They walk, unkempt, a candid truth upheld, their wuthering past now revoked.
